description: This Java class 'IoUtil' provides utility methods for sending commands, changing RPM, waiting for responses, launching simulators, and connecting to hardware within the Rufesi project. It interacts with core components like LinkManager, SensorCentral, and CommandQueue.

classes.name: IoUtil
classes.description: Utility class for IO operations, command handling, and hardware interaction in the Rufesi project.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command and waits for confirmation, throwing an exception if not confirmed.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Overloaded method to send a command with specified retry and total timeout.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a CountDownLatch to reach zero within a specified timeout.

methods.name: changeRpm
methods.description: Changes engine RPM, waits for sensor confirmation, and verifies the change.

methods.name: waitForFirstResponse
methods.description: Waits for the first sensor response indicating the system has started.

methods.name: launchSimulator
methods.description: Starts a simulator process and establishes a TCP connection.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: realHardwareConnect
methods.description: Connects to real hardware via specified port and registers state actions.
